blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five V20 angle views and all six V20 pose renders. Twelve supported fold cycles create more frequent hem ripples, but the neutral/front views still show a hard central gathered mass and the back retains a raised center patch. Crouch and sit still show two narrow pointed tails below the seat. V20 changes pleat frequency only; it does not resolve the visible collapse. Appearance remains rejected.

V20 crouch and sit views still leave the inner-hip and seat coverage boundary unclear where the shorts, thighs and overskirt overlap. Static renders do not establish continuous coverage, clearance or strain; fit and coverage remain unverified and rejected.

V20 front, side, back and posed renders continue to show pronounced triangular faceting and uneven surface finish across the jacket sleeves, shoulders, torso and waist. Surface quality remains rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
